abstract: Verifies deployed salvage master endorsement and hazardous response readiness
system_message:
You are the Emergency salvage commander (SALV), responsible for verifying deployed salvage master endorsements, hazardous response readiness, and related subsea operational support capabilities for salvage vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies deployed salvage master endorsement and hazardous response readiness（COMM）
information_points.content:
SALV-COMM-H22：For Thor Viking Sentinel, the salvage team embarkation manifest confirms that onboard salvage master endorsement is true, with an accredited salvage master logged as active command leader.
SALV-COMM-0MU：For Nordic Resolute Saver, onboard salvage master endorsement is confirmed as true according to the salvage team embarkation manifest.
SALV-COMM-P80：For Highland Endeavour Tug, the salvage team embarkation manifest indicates that onboard salvage master endorsement is false, as no accredited salvage master is logged for active operational command leadership.

information_points.title: Subsea support readiness（DIVING）
information_points.content:
SALV-DIVING-XG4：According to the diving systems audit certificate for Thor Viking Sentinel, the onboard decompression chamber rating provides certified capacity for 6 diver occupants under continuous treatment pressure.
SALV-DIVING-5A3：According to the diving systems audit certificate for Nordic Resolute Saver, the onboard decompression chamber rating is certified for 4 diver occupants under continuous treatment pressure.
SALV-DIVING-GLR：According to the diving systems audit certificate for Highland Endeavour Tug, the onboard decompression chamber rating is certified at 8 diver capacity in the hyperbaric emergency suite.
